text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Refined Chinese ink wash and light mineral-pigment landscape, open empty scholarly reading pavilion in a wet bamboo grove, low wooden writing desk and closed scrolls, ink black architectural brushwork, bamboo green and pale ochre accents, misty negative space and absorbent xuan-paper texture, beautiful spatial depth, absolutely no calligraphy or seals.
